source_verification.reading_scope: 2014 author-uploaded full text equations9,11,13-16; 2021 manuscript facet relation and figure captions; original2020 numerical archive description and selected arrays.
equations: For each facet s_x=drive/(1+alpha_x v A_x/(4 Dv f_v C_delta)); A_a=ac,A_c=a^2.
drive=s_i/[1+H Dstar/Kstar], H=rho_eq L/T (L/(Rv T)-1). The same Dstar and Kstar appear in the mass law.
D_x=Dv/[C/(f_v C_delta)+4 Dv C/(alpha_x v A_x)]; heat transport analogous with the native thermal jump.
Mass=4pi C rho_eq Dstar drive; axes use the2021 dc/da=alpha_c/alpha_a relation.
extensions: Ventilation multiplies only continuum conductance; the supplied f_v and f_T are explicit external controls. This algebra does not supply a habit-specific flow correlation.

source_observations.evidence_state: Observed values from printed numerical labels in additional 2018 experiments; same apparatus/author as 1991; not blind validation

source.rights: Numerical facts transcribed with source attribution; source paper retained only in ignored research cache. No open redistribution license established for the full paper.

source_observations.source_title: Supercooled cloud tunnel studies on the growth of branched planar snow crystals below water saturation
source_observations.source_location: Figure 1, PDF page 2; methods PDF pages 1 and 3
source_observations.verification: Read source text and visually inspected complete Figure 1 labels at 160 dpi; source file hash retained. These numbers are printed labels, not digitized curve coordinates.
source_observations.pressure_status: Site annual mean; individual run pressure not reported
source_observations.temperature_status: Values are the nominal group headings in Figure 1, not exact per-crystal mean temperatures. Figure 2 plots per-crystal temperatures, visibly offset from group headings; use a temperature sensitivity envelope or digitize Figure 2 before claiming exact matched forcing.
source_observations.humidity_conversion: e = e_si(T) + delta_rho_kg_m3 * R_v * T_K. State saturation convention explicitly; do not mistake delta_rho for fractional ice supersaturation.
limitations: Mass, thickness, fall speed and individual initial shape/mass are not reported for these 13 examples.
Figures select 13 of the 62 accepted experiments; they are not an unbiased population distribution.
The 0.008/0.018 g m-3 figures describe temporal variability of excess vapor density, not pointwise measurement uncertainty or per-case confidence intervals.
Maximum size alone cannot validate mass or geometry.
Do not calibrate to these cases and then label them independent validation.

humidity_controls.evidence: Earth diameter comparison with explicit unknown seed shape and flow scenarios; no selected initial-shape or mechanism fit.
limits: Full 10 micrometre initial basal spans; varying thickness also changes initial mass.
Constant dense ice restricted to observed excess vapor <= 0.05 g/m3; branching/hollowing absent.
The factor-two conductance case is imposed; no observed fall-speed history supports it as an experimental reconstruction.
Nominal temperature groups differ from some individual crystal temperatures by several tenths of a degree.
No measured mass/thickness and no exact seed shape; matching a diameter alone cannot validate autonomous growth.
Two selected cases are within the newer empirical morphology-onset range; the dense assumption is a restricted control, not guaranteed observed habit.

source_verification.evidence: Original source bytes verified against recorded identities; no unresolved download is substituted.

measured_shape_rates.evidence: Instantaneous rate diagnostic on supplied observed-fit shapes and falling speeds; derivatives of fits are not new directly measured rates.
limits: Spheroid capacitance and critical-supersaturation approximation are retained; branches are not spatially resolved.
JW source Sc = 0.63 is used and the same factor is assigned to heat and vapor; this is an explicit common-factor sensitivity.
No extrapolation outside the chosen JW Reynolds interval and no unsupported habit substitution; rejected cases have no calculated endpoint.
Planar thickness depends on mass/area, so shape and mass are not three independent measurements.
Inferred deposition densities are diagnostics in both geometries, not adopted laws or silently clipped inputs.

retrieved.evidence: Indexed author-uploaded article text retrieved through the web tool; not original PDF bytes.

source_record.reading_scope: Harrington and Pokrifka 2024 section 3b, Eq.5, surrounding empirical limitations and warm-temperature comparison. Mathematical onset screen only.
caveats: An empirical transition range across heterogeneous measurements, not a universal size-free law or a calibrated deposition-density function.
Some cited experiments show size and pressure dependence. The broad criterion identifies substantial morphological change rather than a resolved transition time.
Original source bytes were not retrieved from the publisher. This record identifies the indexed author-copy excerpt used.
source_record.rights: Retrieved fulltext remains in ignored cache; tracked calculations summarize and cite the primary source.

morphology_screen.evidence: Calculated humidity position relative to a published empirical morphology-onset range; no measured transition time or deposition density is inferred.
limits: The 2024 range describes substantial hollowing/branching across disparate experiments, not a universal sharp transition.
Warm-regime experiments overlap these temperatures but seed shape, size, pressure and history still matter.
The screen supplies no density-amplitude law, arm width or aggregate geometry; it is not installed in a lunar solver.

semianalytic_baseline_parity.evidence: Existing stagnant compact-crystal endpoints reproduced; empirical accuracy is separate.
